No brushwork, drawing outlines, flat illustration, realistic fabric/skin/liquid, plastic, clay or smooth CGI. Exactly ONE finished vertical 9:16 image. This is a new composition, not a crop of the reference.

FINAL COMPOSITION OVERRIDE: Character names in continuity rules are NOT a cast list. Show ONLY the people/animals explicitly requested in THIS single shot.
